mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_failed_message (id, message_id, source_queue, exchange_name, routing_key, body, headers_json, content_type, content_encoding, correlation_id, reason, last_error, occurrences, status, replay_count, create_time, last_failure_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{messageId}, #{sourceQueue}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{body}, #{headersJson}, #{contentType}, #{contentEncoding}, #{correlationId}, #{reason}, #{lastError}, 1, 0, 0, #{createTime}, #{lastFailureTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE occurrences = occurrences + 1, status = 0, last_error = VALUES(last_error), reason = VALUES(reason), last_failure_time = VALUES(last_failure_time), closed_by = NULL, closed_time = NULL, close_reason = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id AS messageId, source_queue AS sourceQueue, exchange_name AS exchangeName, routing_key AS routingKey, reason, last_error AS lastError, occurrences, status, replay_count AS replayCount, last_replay_error AS lastReplayError, replayed_by AS replayedBy, create_time AS createTime, last_failure_time AS lastFailureTime, last_replay_time AS lastReplayTime, closed_by AS closedBy, closed_time AS closedTime, close_reason AS closeReason FROM mq_failed_message WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR status = #{status}) ORDER BY last_failure_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mq_failed_message WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR status = #{status})
SELECT * FROM mq_failed_message WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mq_failed_message WHERE status = 2 AND closed_time < #{cutoff} ORDER BY closed_time, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS messageCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN COALESCE(last_replay_time, last_failure_time) ELSE last_failure_time END) < #{cutoff} THEN 1 END) AS overdueCount FROM mq_failed_message WHERE status IN (0, 1) GROUP BY status
SELECT source_queue AS sourceQueue, reason, COUNT(*) AS messageCount FROM mq_failed_message WHERE last_failure_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) GROUP BY source_queue, reason
